source_scope: model.language_model.* + lm_head.weight only; vision_tower/vision_adapter/multi_modal_projector tensors are counted and skipped

census.status: verify at pack time against the warm safetensors index; contract expects 626 text tensors and 810 skipped vision tensors
census.delta_note: 52x12 kept layer tensors + 3 globals = 627; DESIGN/contract say 626 - packer asserts the pattern counts and reports the one-tensor delta to the manager instead of guessing which side is right (rotary inv_freq buffers are non-persistent and absent from safetensors per the pinned modeling source)

model.language_model.norm.weight.note: plain weighted RMS per the pinned modeling source (MuseGlimmerRMSNorm, with_scale=True), NOT centered

lm_head.weight.note: untied; vocab-parallel row sharding 12628 per tp16 rank

self_attn_q_proj.slice: head-major q rows interleaved with the attention output gate rows inside the fused qgkv projection

self_attn_gate_proj.note: attention OUTPUT gate (sigmoid, elementwise over 32x128 dims), NOT an mlp gate; fused into qgkv

self_attn_k_proj.slice: kv head h is replicated on ranks 8h..8h+7 at tp16

mlp_gate.slice: gate half of the fused stagepack gate_up rows, 1248 local rows per rank, gate_first

mlp_up.slice: up half of the fused stagepack gate_up rows, 1248 local rows per rank
